scientific_integrity: The theorem is supported by a complete order-embedding proof and finite sanity checks; no external audit or proof certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite Gödel chains and their finite direct products only; not all Gödel or Heyting algebras. Gap lower bound need not be sharp. Earlier equivalent formulations may exist.
title: Order-type violation polynomials and finite-gap trichotomy for finite Gödel chains
